thread:
tanya: spike-friendly reservation idea: "graceful-burst tickets" where customers can request a small guaranteed burst for short windows with rate-limited conversions. different from soft-hold in that it's request-driven (CS or API) and requires manual acceptance for conversion.

omar: why manual? seems like more ops work. can we make it automated but with CS notification?

ravi: manual conversion gives us billing oversight, especially for enterprise accounts who want approvals. also helpful for legal/compliance for some regulated customers.

leigh_ops: ops perspective: manual conversion reduces accidental cost spikes. we also need to map which pools are eligible; some pools are strictly reserved for committed customers.

morgan_cs: productizing this as a ticket flow in Console would be ideal. allow CS to approve short requests, with auto-expire. include a checklist: tenant business justification, duration, expected qps, and conversion preference.

tanya: proposed minimal API semantics: POST /tenants/{id}/burst-requests {amount, window_minutes, manual_convert:boolean, justification} -> returns request_id and state (pending, active, expired, converted).

omar: scheduler hooks: burst_request tokens should be mapped to a "reviewable" bucket that participates in spillover but not in auto-conversion thresholds. helps avoid oscillation.

ravi: telemetry: track "burst_request.approved_by", "burst_request.time_to_approval", and business tags so we can link to sales deals.

leigh_ops: alert idea: "burst_request_queue_age" > 30m -> page oncall and CS lead. slow approvals block customers.

morgan_cs: pilot candidates: FinVault and LiveCart. want ability to request via Console or programmatically via API.

tanya: cost guardrail: manual requests capped at 5% of pool by default. conversion to reservation needs a CS approval flow for anything >10%.

omar: timeline: 3 sprints for MVP:
- sprint 1: API + queue + Console request widget
- sprint 2: scheduler mapping + spillover rules + metrics
- sprint 3: approval UI + billing preview + runbook updates

ravi: blockers: need an RBAC extension so CS approvers have limited scope. also need a log entry for approvals for audit.

leigh_ops: add to runbook: if burst_request causes pool_pressure and approved manually, oncall can trigger an emergency preemption to protect steady tenants.

morgan_cs: action: I'll assemble approval matrix and pilot outreach.

omar: action: I'll implement API skeleton and add tests.

tanya: action: I'll mock Console widgets and get design sign-off.

reliability-bot: CI: tests for burst-request API added on branch "burst-requests". Build 324 passed :white_check_mark:

ravi: decision: go-ahead for manual burst_request MVP with the 3-sprint plan. keep conversion gating and RBAC in scope.

leigh_ops: +1 with required kill-switch and pool-eligibility config.

omar: +1, will coordinate with scheduler owners.

morgan_cs: +1, CS ready to pilot with two customers.

tanya: will file RFC and tracking ticket; target pilot in 6 weeks.
